prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 1-8: page #FBF9F9, text #2D261F, accent #79861D, secondary surface #E7EFEB, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Libre Baskerville; geometric heading with a contrasting reading serif. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
